newsitem.title: UK: Warner Village planning European cinema expansion.
newsitem.headline: Warner Village planning European cinema expansion.

text.p: Warner Village cinemas plans a huge expansion programme across Europe, building over 300 new multiplexes with more than 3,000 screens by the millennium, the company said on Thursday.
The two billion pound expansion is expected to create over 30,000 jobs over the next four years, Warner Village said.
The company is a joint venture between Warner Bros and Australia's Village Roadshow.
Warner Village already has 17 multiplexes in the UK and plan to add a further 25 by the year 2000. This will include the country's first 30-screen "megaplex", to be built in Birmingham.
Its multiplex chain will be increased to 20 in Germany and it plans to create a network of up to the same number in Italy, the first of which will be completed this autumn.
The arrival of the multiplex has helped to reverse the long-term decline in cinema audiences in Britain.
Annual attendance has more than doubled from just over 50 million in the mid-1980s to a level of around 125 million.
